dependency_evidence: SV2-GAT-01 merged into dev as pull request 7417; this package asks the brain that route selected and never chooses one itself.
evidence_class: mocked: an in-process fake brain HTTP surface answering the fixture's scoped, legacy, empty, refused and outage responses stands in for brain-api; hooks run in a temporary home with a fake clock; no network call runs
interfaces: hooks.context.project_memory.KernelProjectSource.fetch(identity) asks GET /feed?project=<canonical project id> on the session brain and maps the kernel's arcs and lessons into ProjectMemory with the kernel feed revision, keeping only rows whose projects list is exactly the requested project
An identity with an unknown project id is scoped empty and is never sent to the kernel

Only the legacy fleet feed shape (hot_arcs, inject_blocks or entries and no scope field) falls back to VaultProjectSource, the reconstruction from the stored fleet feed; each such refresh counts once as legacy_endpoint in scoped_feed_fallback_total

A refusal (401 or 403) or an answer whose scope or project id differs from the request raises ScopedFeedRefused; the project cache then stores empty memory, so earlier memory stops being served and no fleet memory replaces it

A transport failure or another HTTP error raises BrainSourceUnavailable; the cached memory of the same brain and project is kept, marked with outage_at, counted as kernel_outage, and served with a Stale project memory line until BRAIN_PROJECT_MEMORY_STALE_SECONDS (default 86400) past its last refresh, then no memory is served
hooks.context.project_cache keys the project memory cache by the session brain and the canonical project id (_project_scope) and stores the kernel revision with the memory
hooks.context.brain_adapter.get_status, the brain_status tool, reports scoped_feed_fallback_total

supported_versions.brain_api: agentibrain-kernel brain-api with GET /feed?project= (project_feed_payload, scope project); older brain-api answering the plain fleet feed is the legacy endpoint
supported_versions.brain_ops: agentibrain-kernel brain-ops project_feed.py writes the projects/<key>.json snapshots whose arc rows carry ref arc:<cluster_id> and whose lesson rows carry content, each with a projects list

states.accepted: A refresh is accepted when the kernel answers scope project for the requested canonical project id; the memory and revision are then written to the project cache under the session brain and project namespace.
states.committed: The project memory cache file and the scoped_feed_fallback_total counter file under the agentihooks home are the only writes; the fleet feed cache is never written by a project refresh.
states.externally_verified: Not yet: no deployed session read a project feed from a live brain-api; a live check belongs to the G6 rollout gate.

metrics.scoped_feed_fallback_total: per reason counts in $AGENTIHOOKS_HOME/brain/project-memory/scoped_feed_fallback_total.json: legacy_endpoint for a refresh served by the vault reconstruction because the brain answered the legacy fleet feed, kernel_outage for a refresh that kept stale cached memory; a scoped empty or refused result never counts

rollback_rehearsal.action: Set BRAIN_PROJECT_FEED_SOURCE=vault to switch the source adapter back to the reconstruction from the fleet feed; marker provenance is untouched and the strict client filter on the identity project stays in VaultProjectSource.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: The brain's own project snapshots and markers; the project memory cache and the fallback counter are derived and are never treated as authoritative.
rollback_rehearsal.proof: test_the_source_setting_selects_the_kernel_by_default_and_the_vault_for_rollback selects VaultProjectSource when the setting is vault and KernelProjectSource otherwise.

remaining_limitations: Kernel decisions and signals in the project feed are not rendered; the project block still carries arcs and lessons only.
Fleet warnings in the project feed are not rendered in the project block; shared warnings keep reaching sessions through the fleet feed broadcast.
The project cache still refreshes when the fleet feed hash changes or its TTL expires, so a project revision change between those points is picked up at the next refresh.

During a brain outage the cached project memory is served for up to BRAIN_PROJECT_MEMORY_STALE_SECONDS after its last refresh, so evidence the brain restricted during that window can still be shown, marked stale; the recovery contract requires this serving and INV-M07 holds again at the first successful refresh or at the policy limit. The operator owns the policy value.

The legacy endpoint is recognised by shape: an answer with no scope field carrying hot_arcs, inject_blocks or entries, which is exactly the plain fleet feed of a brain-api without project scoping; any other answer without a project scope is refused.
The rollback rehearsal is the source selection test and case A's legacy path, which runs VaultProjectSource; a live rollback on a populated cache belongs to the G6 rollout gate.
compatibility: Compared with the preceding accepted path, VaultProjectSource reconstruction from the stored fleet feed: it stays reachable through a legacy brain-api answer and through BRAIN_PROJECT_FEED_SOURCE=vault.
authority: The project comes only from the session's resolved canonical project identity; the brain-api enforces the token's project grant and the client refuses any answer naming another project.
